summary: 6 features and 3 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • saga: add localized goal input guidance to the task panel (10cda00)

HagiCode-org/web

  • conversation: add the sent check morph glyph (ded3d03)
  • hero: include Omp in the preset executor selection (f68b6d8)
  • conversation: route remote speech to question answers (28e8633)
  • conversation: show accepted sends and agent wait status (f8d5300)
  • header: group shell actions and refresh theme lane tokens (5234001)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • prompts: allow ASCII fallback when visualization skill is unavailable (f9d4505)
  • prompts: align OpenSpec headings with Markdown hierarchy (4ed0a6a)

HagiCode-org/web

  • theme: draw category icons for generated themes (cb8a522)
